platform: Fedena — cloud-hosted, web-based education ERP/SIS with native iOS and Android apps and documented self-hosted deployment.

distinctive_features.feature: Apache-licensed open-source origins, plugin architecture, and documented self-hosting.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Technically capable institutions can customize deployment and extend functionality beyond the hosted product.

distinctive_features.feature: Indian assessment workflows including CCE, CBSE-oriented SA/FA, and ICSE grading.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: These workflows address locally relevant assessment and report-card requirements.

distinctive_features.feature: One native mobile app provides administrator, teacher, parent, and student experiences.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Multiple school constituencies can access role-specific tools through a shared mobile product.

distinctive_features.feature: Multi-school dashboards for consolidated group oversight.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Management can monitor multiple institutions through a consolidated view.

distinctive_features.feature: Custom fields, form builder, and configurable report filters and columns.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Institutions can adapt data collection and reporting to local needs without assuming bespoke core development.

distinctive_features.feature: Public API playground with tokenized actions and OAuth/app-frame support.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: IT teams can connect external applications and build integrations using documented interfaces.

weaknesses.issue: Reviewers report maze-like navigation and difficult gradebook and inventory workflows.
Some users report slow or poorly presented support and training.
Users report large-data loading can hang.
Reviews cite pricing pressure for smaller organizations; confirm current quote and module inclusions.
Mobile app ratings are low in the cited listings, with Android demo login complaints.
Customized CSV upload is reported as unsupported in inventory.
Self-hosted community edition may lag commercial releases and requires technical maintenance.
Public materials do not verify UDISE+, APAAR, NEP 2020 HPC, or DPDP readiness.
No public SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification, hosting-region statement, or DPDP readiness evidence was verified.
Fedena identifies itself as an ERP, not a full LMS; Moodle integration is documented.

pricing_model_summary: Annual institutional tiers: Standard $800, Premium $1,120, Ultimate $1,360 during the cited 20% sale; Enterprise is quote-based. Unlimited users; add-ons may vary.
biggest_strategic_gap: Public documentation does not establish modern statutory reporting, dedicated safeguarding or special-education workflows, full LMS functionality, or verified AI capabilities.
